sections.text_helper: Section 9.8.9 "RCC AHB2 peripheral reset register (RCC_AHB2RSTR)" in chapter 9 (Reset and clock control (RCC)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 289.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x064
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:25 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 24 ADC3RST: ADC3 reset
Set and reset by software.
0: ADC3 not reset (default after reset)
1: ADC3 reset
Bits 23:22 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 21 CCBRST: CCB reset
Set and reset by software.
0: CCB not reset (default after reset)
1: CCB reset
Bit 20 SAESRST: SAES reset
Set and reset by software.
0: SAES not reset (default after reset)
1: SAES reset
Bit 19 PKARST: PKA reset
Set and reset by software.
0: PKA not reset (default after reset)
1: PKA reset
Bit 18 RNGRST: RNG reset
Set and reset by software.
0: RNG not reset (default after reset)
1: RNG reset
Bit 17 HASHRST: HASH reset
Set and reset by software.
0: HASH not reset (default after reset)
1: HASH reset
Bit 16 AESRST: AES reset
Set and reset by software.
0: AES not reset (default after reset)
1: AES reset
Bits 15:12 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 11 DAC1RST: DAC reset
Set and reset by software.
0: DAC1 not reset (default after reset)
1: DAC1 reset
Bit 10 ADC12RST: ADC1 and ADC2 reset
Set and reset by software.
0: ADC1 and ADC2 not reset (default after reset)
1: ADC1 and ADC2 reset
Bits 9:8 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 7 GPIOHRST: GPIOH reset
Set and reset by software.
0: GPIOH not reset (default after reset)
1: GPIOH reset
Bit 6 GPIOGRST: GPIOG reset
Set and reset by software.
0: GPIOG not reset (default after reset)
1: GPIOG reset
Bit 5 GPIOFRST: GPIOF reset
Set and reset by software.
0: GPIOF not reset (default after reset)
1: GPIOF reset
Bit 4 GPIOERST: GPIOE reset
Set and reset by software.
0: GPIOE not reset (default after reset)
1: GPIOE reset
Bit 3 GPIODRST: GPIOD reset
Set and reset by software.
0: e GPIOD not reset (default after reset)
1: GPIOD reset
Bit 2 GPIOCRST: GPIOC reset
Set and reset by software.
0: GPIOC not reset (default after reset)
1: GPIOC reset
Bit 1 GPIOBRST: GPIOB reset
Set and reset by software.
0: GPIOB not reset (default after reset)
1: GPIOB reset
Bit 0 GPIOARST: GPIOA reset
Set and reset by software.
0: GPIOA not reset (default after reset)
1: GPIOA reset
